records.title: RCS - UDAN in Rajasthan
details:
(b): Uttarlai Airport, owned by the Indian Air Force (IAF), has been
identified for development under the UDAN scheme. Routes connecting Uttarlai to Jaipur have been awarded to M/s FlyBig for operation of 19 seater aircraft. The Airports Authority of India (AAI) has proposed to establish a civil enclave at Uttarlai Airport using its internal resources.

records.title: Artificial Canal and Port Project in Bakhasar
details: (a) to (f) Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI), an autonomous body under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways has engaged National Technology Centre for Ports, Waterways & Coasts (NTCPWC), IIT Madras for carrying out mathematical modelling of the National Waterway (NW) - 48 (Jawai-Luni River and Rann of Kutch) which passes through Barmer district also. Further course of action will be decided based on the outcome of mathematical modelling.

records.title: Construction of Port In Rajasthan
details: (a) & (e): Government of Rajasthan has prepared pre-feasibility report on development of port at Bhawtara, near Bakhasar of Barmer. Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) has prepared feasibility report of National Waterway-48 (Jawai-Luni Rivers and Rann of Kutch) and has awarded the work for carrying out the mathematical modelling of the waterway to National Technology Centre for Ports, Waterways and Coasts (NTCPWC), IIT Madras on 01.10.2024. Further course of action for development of the port depends on the outcome of the mathematical modelling.
